title: F-Atlas delivery slips caused Account 03 deal regression
narrative: Engineering repeatedly missed milestones for the F-Atlas feature. This directly blocked Account 03's migration, leading to a flood of support tickets and ultimately causing their deal to regress to evaluation with a 40% forecast cut.

title: Forced metered billing migration triggered Account 05 churn risk
narrative: Account 05 was forced onto a usage-metered plan, which immediately triggered a billing dispute in support. Consequently, the CRM forecast was cut by 45% due to pricing-related renewal risks.

title: Ingest API instability drove Account 07 usage collapse post-sale
narrative: Shortly after Account 07's deal was marked closed-won, they experienced severe Ingest API outages resulting in multiple Sev-1 tickets. This technical failure caused their API usage to plummet by 59%.

title: Champion departure caused Account 11 engagement and usage drop
narrative: The primary champion at Account 11 left the company, leading to an immediate cessation of support tickets. Without their champion driving adoption, API usage steadily declined by 26% over the following weeks.
